attributes.name: Deadeye Pistol +1
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d6+1. You may additionally shuffle this card into your deck to add another 1d6.

Shuffle this card into your deck to add 1d6 to a combat check by another character at your location.

If proficient with weapons, when you play this card, you may put this card on top of your deck instead of shuffling it into your deck. If the bane requires subsequent combat checks, add another 1d6 to each of those checks.
